answer: Make new identities earn voting weight slowly through staked collateral that unlocks only after months of honest grading. A Sybil operator can spin up a nebula of fake agents overnight, but each one starts with near-zero influence and must lock real coins. If graders catch the cluster submitting near-identical work, the stakes are slashed together, so a gale of cheap accounts leaves only an umber smear of lost funds instead of captured votes.
